title: 8-Mode Ring Sustained Mode Hold (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `mode_hold` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Tests whether a trainer can acquire and continuously hold all 8 modes of a 2D Gaussian ring at high sample quality (hq >= 0.90) across 1,200 updates without late-stage mode dropout or oscillation.
failure_mode: Recipes that pass early acquisition often oscillate or shed modes over sustained updates when critic damping or minimax contraction (Law 4.5) is missing.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `mode_hold` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
